summary: Opening an agent in the terminal UI shows its conversation by default, while explicit terminal-first choices and saved terminal tabs are preserved

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No schema changes or data rewrites. Existing optional device preference fields distinguish an unset default from an explicit choice.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Explicit conversation_first false and legacy terminal_first true keep terminal-first behavior. Legacy terminal_first false is an unset choice; an explicit conversation_first takes precedence. Saved terminal tabs and manual attach are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No additional startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No action required. Turn off Conversation first in Ctrl+K to open agents on their terminals on this device.

recovery.detail: No preference format change; older clients can still read saved choices.
